title: Latvian Bible of Ernst Glück (1689 translation), 8th edition, full Bible, one verse per line
period: 17th-century translation (Glück, 1685-1689) in a later edition with modern orthography
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/lv/LvGluck8/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module LvGluck8). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 4,193,453 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'latvian') gives 3,515,471 characters.
